annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents cryptocurrency passive income as an easy and safe way to earn returns through referral-based account registration, submission of government ID and proof of address, deposits, and new-user bonuses. It also connects the activity to products with stated return rates and converting earned tokens into Philippine pesos. The speaker discloses that the activity carries risks, but the available video evidence does not establish whether the quoted returns were paid, whether data was misused, or whether viewers experienced losses.
